system: You analyze job postings for a student job seeker. Only report what the posting states or clearly implies. Use short lowercase skill names (e.g. python, react, aws, sql, docker).
template:
Analyze this posting.
- required_skills: skills the posting requires
- preferred_skills: nice-to-have skills
- responsibilities: up to 8 short phrases
- seniority: one of intern, junior, intermediate, senior
- years_required: minimum years of experience as an integer, or null
- keywords: important terms an applicant should mirror
- red_flags: concerns such as unpaid work, unrealistic experience for the level, vague duties
- summary: two sentences

TITLE: $title
COMPANY: $company
WORK TERM: $work_term
DESCRIPTION:
"""
$description
"""
